## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the existing scope issues.

## Validation

Record relevant checks and results. For affected device behavior, identify the exact source/build and distinguish physical observations from automated checks. State remaining acceptance work.

## Documentation and distribution check

- [ ] Reviewed release notes, privacy behavior/baseline, setup guidance, dependency/version descriptions and permissions against this change.
- Documents updated, or why no update is needed:
- Before any distribution: record the exact artifact and previous channel version, repeat the [required documentation check](https://github.com/YusukeIt0/dot-link/blob/main/docs/development.md#required-documentation-check-for-every-change-and-distribution), and resolve discrepancies. Record this in the existing PR/issue/release; do not treat this PR as distribution approval.
